title: Identica-CommandBlocker
description: Addon-plugin for Identica that blocks commands during authentication.
body:
Addon-plugin for [Identica](https://modrinth.com/plugin/identica) that blocks commands during authentication.

### Requirements

* **Identica:** 3.0.0+
* **Platforms:** Velocity, BungeeCord

### Installation

1. Download the latest version of Identica-CommandBlocker from [Versions](https://modrinth.com/plugin/identica-commandblocker/versions).
2. Place the .jar file into the plugins folder.
3. Restart the server to generate the configuration and necessary files.
